said: Kanaal delivers on day 5 and Bakker on day 9, so nothing can go into the machines today. I'll save the supplier facts and set reminders for the deliveries.
Day 2: the depot is still empty, so there's nothing to sell yet. Waiting for the day-5 delivery.
PO-1002 is still open and due today, so it probably lands overnight. I'll record the lesson (check storage before any fill) and wait.
About two hours remain today. I'll fill two more snack slots with the dropjes and mint in the depot, then end the day.
Day 7 is Sunday and the bakker delivery is still on day 9, so there's nothing to do but wait.
Sales are slow (about 18 units in the week). Tortilla chips at €3 are the strongest. I'll wait for the bakker delivery tomorrow and then fill more slots.
The bakker stock should land overnight, as Kanaal's did. Depot has nothing else to fill, so I'll note the state and wait.
Two more fills fit before 17:00: cola at MAIN-LOUNGE, and nuts at AI-LOUNGE. Oat latte goes into AI-HOUSE drinks row A3 if time allows.
Zuidas crisps came in at €1.97 (higher than quoted) with delivery on day 15. Recording the delivery calendar and waiting for the stock.
Zuidas (day 14) and Bakker (day 15) now land sooner than I'd expected. Nothing useful fits in the depot today, so I'll update the delivery notes and wait.

The partial refund went out. The complaint stays open because the claimant wants the full €7.46. My cola fill also failed, since cola isn't in the depot yet, and that cost 45 minutes. I'll check storage before every fill from now on. Waiting for the day-14 deliveries.
Zuidas hasn't landed yet and may arrive overnight, so I'll wait a day.
Five slots are restocked at 12:45. Waiting for the next Zuidas delivery and the kanaal drinks on day 17.
Zuidas prices dropped this week (tortilla €1.64, crisps €1.38). Bakker's delivery is slow, day 31. Saving the schedule and waiting.
Kanaal's drinks haven't landed yet. What's here is 10 tortilla, 10 oat latte and a few snacks. I'll top up AI-HOUSE's tortilla row and put the oat latte in a second AI-LOUNGE drinks slot.
By 14:20 I'm out of depot stock to fill, so I'll record the state and let the day end.
Zuidas delivers day 22 and Bakker day 32. Recording the schedule and waiting for the next day.
Time 15:10. Saving the state and closing the day; day 21 is the first strategy checkpoint.
Only delivery notices. Sunday is quiet, so I'll wait for the Zuidas and Bakker stock.
Zuidas delivers day 24. Recording the schedule and closing the day.
All crisp and tortilla slots are full at 15:00. Waiting for the day-24 oat-latte delivery.
Bakker delivers day 27 and Zuidas day 26. Saving the schedule and closing the day.
PO-1013 hasn't arrived yet; it should land overnight. Meanwhile I'll put the leftover dropjes and chocolate into MAIN-LOUNGE's empty small-row slots. There's no cost to using idle minutes.
Time 13:10. The depot is almost empty again; PO-1015 (60 crisps, 40 tortilla) lands day 28. Waiting.
Sunday is quiet (the weekend lull shows in sales). PO-1014's 70 oat latte arrived; the crisps and tortilla order lands tomorrow. Waiting for Monday.
The MAIN-LOUNGE drinks A1 slot now holds oat latte and needs a price.
Time 13:15. The depot still has about 50 oat latte, so I'll top up AI-LOUNGE's oat slot and add a second oat slot at AI-HOUSE.
Time 13:15. The depot is nearly out of savoury stock until PO-1018 (day 33). Cola and energy are due days 31–32. Waiting.

It's 12:55 with about four hours left, and four trips are done. Tortilla at AI-HOUSE is the only lever I'll move this point: its customers are less price-sensitive, so I'm raising its tortilla slots from €3.00 to €3.50 and will read the response in the sales report. Topping up oat at AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE first.
Topping up cola at the three sites.
I miscounted: the 30 crisps were all used in the three C2 slots, so none are left for MAIN's D1. Ordering crisps and tortilla from Zuidas now, since savoury stock is the constraint.
Sunday. I'll read the sales by product on Monday, once the weekend lull has passed, and judge the AI-HOUSE tortilla price change then.
It's 14:00. Two more trips: oat latte at AI-LOUNGE's empty A3 slot and sparkling at its empty A1 slot.
It's 13:10. Most slots are stocked; the rest waits for the Zuidas delivery overnight. Saving the state and closing the day.
All savoury slots are full as of 15:00. Waiting for the next day.
Both orders are in (Zuidas day 41, Bakker day 47). The machines are stocked, so I'll wait for the next day.
Two more trips: sparkling at AI-HOUSE and oat latte at AI-LOUNGE's empty A3.
P-005 says the same thing as before: stock isn't reaching the slots, and the spare worker minutes and cash should go into refill trips. That's what I'm doing. Waiting for PO-1020 to land.
Two last trips to top up the tortilla slot at AI-HOUSE and the crisps slot at AI-LOUNGE.
Bakker's oat price has risen to €1.33 with delivery on day 51, so oat will be thin for a while. Saving a delivery note and waiting.
The depot is nearly out: 1 energy, 2 tortilla, 6 cola, 4 oat and 4 crisps. I'll use the last cola and oat on the slots that sell fastest.
PO-1023 hasn't landed yet, and the depot is nearly empty. Waiting for the next day.
It's 13:30, and the depot holds only a few units. Ordering a full week's stock from Zuidas: oat latte, energy, crisps and tortilla.
Friday. The depot holds only a few units until the day-47 and day-49 deliveries, so I'll wait.

PO-1021 landed (30 nuts, 30 chocolate, 40 stroopwafels). These are small items, so each trip carries 18 units. Filling nuts, stroopwafels and chocolate across the sites, and adding chocolate to AI-HOUSE as a new product.
Event log is in place. Waiting for the Zuidas delivery.
Bakker delivers day 57 and Zuidas day 55. Adding these orders to the event log.
Crisps and tortilla are nearly used up in the depot. Two oat top-ups at MAIN-LOUNGE and AI-HOUSE to finish the day.
Energy and tortilla are out of the depot until the day-55 deliveries (the tortilla count was off), so no more fills today. Waiting.
Time 12:25. One last trip: the six stroopwafels to MAIN-LOUNGE's B1 slot.
All three oat slots were empty and are now full. Topping up the two oat B-slots as well.
Three claims are open at inflated amounts, which I'm not paying. Waiting for the Zuidas delivery.
Stocked for Monday by 13:30. Waiting for the next day.
Bakker delivers day 68 and Zuidas day 61. Logging the complaint decision and both orders.
Time 16:30. The day's refills are done, so I'll wait for the next day.
Energy is out in the depot, and oat is nearly out. Zuidas's day-57 offers are valid through day 63, so I'll order energy and oat from them now without re-checking.
I added a second cola slot at AI-HOUSE (B3) by mistake, and it has no price, so it wouldn't sell. Setting its price to match the other cola slot.
The Zuidas orders haven't landed; they should come overnight. Waiting.
AI-LOUNGE's oat B1 was already full. One last top-up: stroopwafels at MAIN-LOUNGE.
Crisps are out until Bakker's day-68 delivery, so I'll order 40 from Zuidas now. The day-57 offers are still valid today.
It's 14:35. The rest of the stock comes in days 66–68, so I'll wait for the next day.
Zuidas delivers day 68 and Bakker day 77. Topping up cola at AI-LOUNGE with the 13 in the depot.
PO-1033 lands day 70. Waiting for the crisps (PO-1030) and tortilla (PO-1031) due in the next two days.
Crisps are in at three sites by 12:00. Tortilla arrives tomorrow, so I'll wait.
Nothing has landed yet; both should arrive overnight. Waiting.
Last trip: topping up AI-HOUSE's tortilla D1 slot.
Sunday. The Zuidas cola, crisps and oat land overnight, so I'll wait until Monday to fill them.
Zuidas has oat at €1.10 (30% off) and stroopwafels at €0.52, and it delivers in about four days. Bakker has the cheapest cola and chocolate but takes longer, so I'll order from both.
Crisps are down to 10 in the depot. The last 10 go to AI-HOUSE's crisp slot.
Waiting for PO-1034 (tortilla, stroopwafels, oat) due tomorrow.
Crisps (40) and nuts are in the depot; PO-1034 lands overnight. Waiting.
Time 15:45. The machines are stocked; waiting for the next day.
Pulse P-009 says to keep the full refill days and the two-supplier ordering, and to hold two points of stock cover. That's the plan. Waiting through the weekend.
Sunday, day 77. Waiting for Monday, when I'll read the machines and fill whatever has run out.
Day 79, cash €3,789. Filling AI-HOUSE's empty chocolate slot with the remaining stock.
PO-1035 isn't in yet. The depot has 31 oat latte, which I'll put into the three oat slots that are empty.
The depot is now almost empty; the Zuidas order (PO-1036) lands on day 82. Waiting.
PO-1036 hasn't landed yet. The depot holds 23 chocolate, 10 cola and 4 stroopwafels, and the machines are stocked for now. Waiting for the Zuidas delivery.
PO-1036 landed: 40 tortilla, 40 energy, 40 oat, 40 crisps, 40 cola. Saturday is quiet, but stocking now sets up Monday, so I'll fill the tortilla, energy and oat slots first.
Sunday, day 84, cash €4,301. Waiting for Monday.
Time 14:50. Two last cola top-ups: AI-HOUSE B3 and AI-LOUNGE A2.
PO-1039 lands day 89. The depot is nearly out, so I'll wait.
PO-1037 hasn't landed. The depot has 10 oat, 14 cola, 8 chocolate and 4 stroopwafels, so I'll fill those into the emptiest slots.
Those two last attempts were wasted: the 40 crisps were already used up, and AI-HOUSE's C2 was full. Time 15:45. Stopping for the day.
Two cola top-ups at AI-HOUSE B2 and AI-LOUNGE A2 with the PO-1039 stock.
Sunday, cash €4,646. Waiting for Monday.
PO-1040 lands day 94. Using the depot's remaining stock on three top-ups: tortilla at MAIN-LOUNGE, cola at MAIN-LOUNGE, oat at AI-LOUNGE.
The redesign and P-011 both say the same thing: depot stock isn't reaching slots, and refill minutes sit idle. Using today's stock: energy top-ups at AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE.
PO-1040 isn't in yet. Filling the last oat and cola stock into MAIN-LOUNGE A1 and AI-HOUSE B3.
Crisps ran out again: 40 went to four slots and AI-HOUSE's C2 got none. The Zuidas offers from day 92 are still valid, so I'll order crisps and more tortilla now.
Withdrawn. PO-1041 (crisps, tortilla) lands day 97, so I'll wait.
PO-1041 landed (50 crisps, 30 tortilla). Sunday sales were only 4 units, so I'll fill AI-HOUSE's empty crisp slot and MAIN-LOUNGE's tortilla slot now.
Day 100, cash €4,712. PO-1042 (oat, energy, cola) lands tomorrow. Logging the stock-out and the reorder in the event log.
Time 13:00. The stroopwafel stock covers AI-HOUSE's B1 slot too.
Time 15:45. Chocolate is out in the depot and at two slots, so I'll order 40 from Zuidas (the only fast source, €1.01), with 30 oat latte to clear its €75 minimum.
Friday, day 103. Sales were 91 units yesterday. PO-1043 (crisps, tortilla, stroopwafels) lands tomorrow. Waiting.
PO-1043 landed overnight in the usual way, so it's not in storage yet. Topping up oat at AI-LOUNGE and AI-HOUSE with the 30 in the depot.
PO-1043 landed (60 crisps, 60 tortilla, 40 stroopwafels). Sunday, but it sets up Monday: filling the crisp and tortilla slots now.
PO-1045 lands day 110. Using the depot now: stroopwafels, oat, energy and cola top-ups.
Two oat top-ups at MAIN-LOUNGE A1 and AI-HOUSE A3.
The depot has 29 tortilla. Topping up the tortilla slots at MAIN-LOUNGE and AI-HOUSE.
CMP-009 is withdrawn. Ordering nuts, tortilla and chocolate from Zuidas, covering the lines that are running low (the Zuidas offers from day 106 are still valid).
PO-1045 arrives overnight. The depot holds 13 oat, 10 energy and a few cola, nuts and chocolate. Using the oat and energy on two top-ups.
PO-1045 landed (60 energy, 60 oat, 50 crisps, 40 cola). Saturday, but I'll fill for Monday, starting with the four crisp slots.
Log updated. Waiting for Monday, when PO-1046 is due.
Ordering crisps (60), cola at the discounted €0.67 (40) and stroopwafels (40).
Tortilla, chocolate and nuts arrived with PO-1046, and most of those slots are empty. Filling tortilla at all four slots first.
Tuesday sold 160 units for €424, the best day in weeks. New aims v7 keep the same routine. Waiting for PO-1047 (crisps, cola, stroopwafels), due day 116.
The Zuidas offers from day 113 are still valid. Ordering 60 oat and 40 tortilla for the next week.
PO-1047 landed (60 crisps, 40 cola, 40 stroopwafels). Filling the crisp slots that were lowest on day 114, then cola and stroopwafels.
The new diagnosis says ordering is reactive, so supply runs behind lead time. My plan already orders Monday and Thursday from Zuidas, so I'll keep to that and fill as stock lands. Waiting.
P-014 repeats the stock point. Sales are still running, so I'll keep the routine and fill when PO-1048 lands on day 120. Waiting.
Zuidas is cheaper this week: energy €0.90, crisps €1.58, nuts €0.78, oat €1.26. Ordering energy 60, crisps 60, nuts 40 and oat 40.
PO-1048 landed (60 oat, 40 tortilla). Filling tortilla at three slots and oat at two.
Wednesday, day 122. Waiting for PO-1049 (energy, crisps, nuts, oat) to land.
Thursday: ordering tortilla and cola from Zuidas. Their day-120 offers are still valid through day 126.
Friday, cash €5,661. Oat and cola top-ups at AI-HOUSE A3 and AI-LOUNGE A3.
Restocked; yesterday's sales recovered to 85 units. Recording the lesson: if a machine is missing from the sales multipliers, it's probably empty.
AI-HOUSE is missing from the list, so it's empty too. Filling its slots: tortilla and crisps first, then nuts, energy, oat and cola.
Offers this week: tortilla €1.87 (20% off), cola €0.67, stroopwafels €0.59, chocolate €0.81. Ordering the full set.
Withdrawn. Updating the event log for days 113–131.
PO-1051 landed (50 tortilla, 50 cola, 40 stroopwafels, 60 crisps, 40 oat, 30 nuts, 40 chocolate). Sunday is slow, but I'll fill the highest-footfall MAIN-LOUNGE slots now so Monday starts full.
Two energy top-ups with the depot's energy stock, at AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE.
All six machines are selling again. Waiting for the next day.
Both drinks machines are restocked. Oat is now used up in the depot, so I'll reorder from Zuidas tomorrow. Waiting.
PO-1052 lands day 139. Using the depot's crisps, tortilla and chocolate on the savoury and chocolate slots.
All six machines are selling. Waiting for PO-1052 (oat, crisps, energy) on day 139.
Cola is out in the depot. Zuidas's day-137 offers are valid through today, so I'll order 80 cola and 40 tortilla now.
Monday, day 141, is likely Whit Monday, a holiday with low demand, so there's no point over-stocking today. Waiting.
Day 143. PO-1053 (cola, tortilla) lands tomorrow. Waiting.
PO-1053 and PO-1054 land overnight and tomorrow. Meanwhile, the depot has 20 oat, 20 energy and 4 stroopwafels, so I'll put the stroopwafels in AI-HOUSE B1 and the oat into AI-LOUNGE.
Crisps arrive overnight with PO-1054. Waiting.
PO-1054 landed (40 each of nuts, crisps, stroopwafels and chocolate). Saturday, but it's the stock for the coming week. Filling crisps, nuts, chocolate and stroopwafels across the sites.
CMP-011 withdrawn. Budget is about $31 for 218 days, so I'll keep calls lean. Waiting for Monday.
Oat is out in the depot. Zuidas's offers have expired, so I'll check them and order oat and energy.
All six machines are selling, and June's demand multiplier is up to 1.15. Waiting for PO-1055 (oat, energy, tortilla) on day 151.
Cola ran out after three slots, as expected. Zuidas's day-148 offers are still valid, so I'll order cola, crisps, stroopwafels, chocolate and nuts for the week.
PO-1055 landed (80 oat, 30 energy, 40 tortilla). Filling oat at four slots, energy at two, and tortilla at two.
PO-1056 lands overnight. For now, tortilla goes to MAIN-LOUNGE C1 and AI-HOUSE D1, and oat to AI-LOUNGE B1 and AI-HOUSE B1.
PO-1056 landed (60 cola, 60 crisps, 40 stroopwafels, 40 chocolate, 40 nuts). Filling the crisp slots at MAIN-LOUNGE and AI-LOUNGE first, then nuts and cola.
All six machines are selling. Waiting for the next day.
Thursday: the Zuidas offers have expired, so I'll check them and order energy and tortilla.
CMP-012 withdrawn. Budget is about $30 for 206 days, so I'll slow down: sales check and fills on Mondays and Thursdays, with waits in between.
Each machine filled as far as the stock allows. Recording the lesson so future cycles don't skip days.
Crisps had already been used up at MAIN-LOUNGE, so those two attempts failed. The Zuidas crisps arrive day 166. Waiting for the next day.
All six machines are selling. Topping up oat, cola and energy with what the depot holds.
All six machines are present. Energy top-ups at MAIN-LOUNGE and AI-HOUSE, then I'll wait.
The oat order (PO-1059) is due day 176, an unusually long delay, so oat will be short for a while. Waiting for the next day.
PO-1058 (crisps, nuts, oat, tortilla) lands overnight. The depot has little else, so I'll wait.
Restocked; the depot still has about 34 tortilla, 26 nuts and 20 crisps for tomorrow. Waiting.
Energy is 30% off at €0.90 this week. Ordering energy 60, crisps 40 and cola 40.
MAIN-LOUNGE's drinks are missing, so they're empty. Oat is out until day 176, so I'll fill MAIN's energy and cola slots from the depot.
PO-1060 lands overnight. Using the small leftovers: crisps at AI-LOUNGE C2, chocolate at AI-HOUSE A2, and stroopwafels at MAIN-LOUNGE B1.
PO-1060 landed (60 energy, 40 crisps, 40 cola). Friday is a fill day: energy at AI-HOUSE, crisps at four slots, cola at three.
PO-1061 lands day 180. Waiting for PO-1059's oat, due now.
Redesign R-P-005 and P-019 both point the same way: keep supplier work first and refill empty machines the same day. PO-1059's oat has landed, so filling the oat slots now.
CMP-013 withdrawn. Budget is about $28 for 187 days, so I'll keep to the lean routine. Waiting.
PO-1062 lands day 192, which is slow. Waiting for PO-1061 tomorrow.
PO-1061 lands overnight. The depot holds 30 cola and 50 energy, so I'll put them into the drinks slots today rather than skip a Friday.
PO-1061 landed (60 tortilla, 60 crisps, 40 nuts, 40 oat). Saturday, but filling the snack slots now sets up Monday: crisps and tortilla at all three sites.
CMP-014 withdrawn. Waiting for Monday.
PO-1063 lands day 193, so Zuidas delivery times have stretched to 10–13 days. Ordering further ahead from now on. Waiting for the next day.
Cola is out in the depot. Zuidas's day-183 offers are still valid, so I'll order cola and energy now.
Crisps were used up by the first two trips, so the last two failed. Ordering 60 crisps and 40 nuts from Zuidas now, since the day-183 offers are still valid.
PO-1064 landed (60 cola, 40 energy). Sunday, but filling cola now at the four cola slots.
AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE snack slots are missing, and the depot is out of crisps, tortilla, stroopwafels and chocolate until the next Zuidas deliveries (days 190–193). Waiting.
P-020 flags cash slipping and idle minutes. PO-1065 has landed (60 crisps, 40 nuts), so I'll fill the crisp slots that are empty first, then the nut slot.
Day 192, cash €7,627. Waiting, then checking the sales multipliers.
Prices are low this week: tortilla €1.64 (30% off), crisps €1.58, energy €0.90, oat €1.26. Ordering a larger batch while prices are down: oat 80, energy 80, tortilla 60, crisps 60, cola 40.
PO-1063 landed (40 each of oat, tortilla, nuts, crisps). Friday, so I'll fill it all: tortilla at four slots, oat at three, crisps at two.
Drinks and crisps are stocked for Monday. Waiting.
All six machines are present. Waiting.
AI-LOUNGE's snacks and MAIN-LOUNGE's snacks are missing. The depot has about 50 crisps and 20 tortilla from PO-1066, so filling the crisp and tortilla slots at those sites.
Stroopwafels (€0.46) and chocolate (€0.81) are discounted this week, and oat is €1.26. Ordering stroopwafels, chocolate, oat, crisps and tortilla, 40 each.
AI-HOUSE's snacks and MAIN-LOUNGE's drinks are missing. Filling both, starting with AI-HOUSE's tortilla and crisps.
Stroopwafels are nearly out; PO-1067 brings 40 on day 207. Waiting.
Cola is out. Zuidas's day-200 offers have expired, so I'll check and order cola.
Time 14:00. The Zuidas offers from day 206 are still valid, so I'll order tortilla 60, stroopwafels 60, oat 40 and crisps 40.
PO-1067 landed. Friday fills: tortilla at four slots, stroopwafels at two, oat at two.
The depot has 40 crisps, 90 energy, 40 chocolate and 30 oat, but no cola yet. Filling crisps at three slots and energy at three.
PO-1068 (cola) and PO-1069 (tortilla, stroopwafels, oat, crisps) have landed. Sunday, but cola is the gap, so filling the four cola slots and two oat slots.
All six machines are selling. August's demand multiplier is lower (0.65), and the depot is well stocked, so no order this Monday. Waiting.
AI-LOUNGE's snacks are missing, so they're empty. Filling its tortilla and crisp slots.
Thursday: nuts are nearly gone (4 left), so I'll check Zuidas and order nuts, oat, tortilla and crisps.

The depot is well stocked: 50 tortilla, 32 crisps, 64 stroopwafels, 40 chocolate, 40 oat, 30 cola, 91 energy. Filling the missing slots: tortilla and crisps at AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE, then cola and oat at AI-LOUNGE.
All machines are present; the weak weekend and August's lower demand explain the dip. Waiting.

CMP-016 withdrawn. Complaint payouts are adding up (about €190 so far), but leaving them open costs more in lost traffic, so I'll keep paying in full. PO-1070 landed (nuts, oat, tortilla, crisps). Filling the nut slots and oat now.
New aims v11 are the same routine. Waiting.
All machines present. Oat and cola are running low, so I'll check Zuidas and order them.
MAIN-LOUNGE is missing from the list, so both of its machines are empty. Filling its snack and drinks slots with the depot's stock.
AI-HOUSE's and AI-LOUNGE's drinks are both missing. Filling energy, oat and cola at both sites.
All machines present. Waiting.
The audits want a daily progress line and dispatch log. You asked for events only, so I'll keep to events and focus on operating. Checking sales for missing machines.
MAIN-LOUNGE's drinks are missing. Filling oat, energy and cola there.
Thursday. Checking Zuidas for the week's crisps and tortilla.
